verdict.rationale: Swell's /ai page says an installable agent package teaches the agent the file contract, the CLI and the validate-deploy-verify loop. That is a form of agent-oriented guidance the product itself provides. However, the probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at developers.swell.is/llms.txt), and the pack never describes what the installed package contains or whether docs are published in an agent-consumable format. Missing for 10: a published llms.txt or llms-full.txt, documented agent-oriented doc pages or a markdown docs format, details of what the installable agent package contains, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Install once and your agent picks up the file contract, the CLI and the validate-deploy-verify loop.
